
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/nolca/p/19974680" title="发布于 2026-05-05 12:38">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">正式出版物: typst vs markdown(pandoc) vs latex</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>当时typst还不成熟，所以采用了 <a href="https://github.com/AClon314/md2doc" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">pandoc模板</a> 的方案。<br>
折腾这个pandoc方案还需要维护一个比较复杂的模板框架与年久失修的filter插件。<br>
目前也在学习typst，感觉适合有编程基础的学，毕竟 <code>#开头</code> 的都是代码/命令。<br>
希望typst能变成pandoc的替代品，pandoc的ppt转译器或其架构不太好调整了，也比较久没维护了，没有新功能。</p>
<h1 id="需求">需求</h1>
<p>先总结</p>
<ul>
<li>pandoc虽然支持格式广泛，但如果要做到正式出版物的程度，要折腾，消耗很多精力，找各种第三方插件，还有各种坑。可能会出现，我明明在写文章，但我得先去修复插件的bug 😂。如果一定需要支持<strong>可编辑的doc/ppt</strong>，再考虑pandoc+markdown吧。
<ul>
<li>slidev支持从markdown生成网页交互式ppt，也可以折腾一个slidev模板。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>latex 尾大不掉，我没用过所以无法深入评价。</li>
<li>typst，性能新星，官方云服务支持多人编辑，排版够用，但对中文支持欠缺。相对markdown要学更多，是一种可编程的文章格式(<a href="https://www.mdxjs.cn/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">mdx</a>: 有人说我吗)。
<ul>
<li>仍然需要用pandoc从typst转doc</li>
<li>插件导出的ppt是烘焙图片的只读形式，缺乏动态的交互。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="导出docpptpandoc胜出">导出doc&amp;ppt:pandoc胜出</h2>
<p>楼主用过pandoc折腾过毕业论文，所以<strong>必须要支持导出到docx</strong>给老师看，如果支持ppt方便答辩展示则是一个加分项。</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pandoc.org/MANUAL.html#general-options" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">pandoc</a>: 双向转换，支持最多的格式，生成<strong>可编辑</strong>的pptx与docx</li>
<li><a href="https://typst.app/docs/web-app/export-and-preview/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">typst</a>: 官方支持 PDF, PNG, SVG, HTML. 插件支持 <a href="https://typst.app/universe/package/typslides" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">图片烘焙的静态只读PPT</a>, <a href="https://github.com/typst/typst/discussions/2561" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">DOC</a></li>
<li>latex: 貌似官方只能导出pdf，latex与其他格式互转需要借助pandoc</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="toc目录生成">TOC目录生成</h2>
<p>TODO: 不知道 自定义目录样式 谁的上限高，不过应该都挺折腾的，不评价。<br>
pandoc导出的 docx 还需要进 word 二次编辑。</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/wiki/Pandoc-Tricks#using-markdown-templates" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">pandoc</a>: 比较鸡肋, 见issue: <a href="https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/discussions/10609" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">目录无法单开一页</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml"># pandoc --defaults=conf.yaml
toc: true
toc-depth: 4
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://typst.app/docs/reference/model/outline/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">typst</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-typst">#outline()
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.overleaf.com/learn/latex/Table_of_contents" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">latex</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-latex">\tableofcontents
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="引用typst胜出">引用:typst胜出</h2>
<h3 id="联动生成参考文献">联动生成参考文献</h3>
<p>typst和latex很方便，pandoc折腾好了还行</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://pandoc.org/demo/example33/9-citations.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">pandoc</a>, 需2个独立文件</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/AClon314/md2doc/blob/main/ref.bib" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><code>.bib</code>记录引用的文献</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/AClon314/md2doc/blob/main/conf/china-national-standard-gb-t-7714-2015-numeric.csl" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><code>.csl</code>设置其格式</a></li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-markdown">这里引用AClon的文献。 [@ref_2026]

&lt;!-- 参考文献 --&gt;

::: {#refs}
:::
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://typst.app/docs/reference/model/cite/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">typst</a>, <a href="https://typst.app/docs/reference/model/bibliography/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">参考文献</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-typst">这里引用AClon的文献。@ref_2026 @cite_id.
你也可以显式地调用`cite`命令: #cite(&lt;ref_2026&gt;)

#bibliography("ref.bib")
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.overleaf.com/learn/latex/Bibliography_management_in_LaTeX" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">latex</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-latex">这里引用AClon的文献。\citet{ref_2026}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="脚注">脚注</h3>
<p>语法上都各有所好，有的长点，有的短点，不评价。</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://pandoc.org/demo/example33/8.19-footnotes.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">pandoc</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-markdown">Here is a footnote reference,[^1] and another.[^longnote]
[^1]: Here is the footnote.
[^longnote]: Here's one with multiple blocks.
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://typst.app/docs/reference/model/footnote/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">typst</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-typst">You can edit Typst documents online.
#footnote[https://typst.app/app] &lt;fn&gt;
Checkout Typst's website. @fn
And the online app. #footnote(&lt;fn&gt;)
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.overleaf.com/learn/latex/Footnotes" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">latex</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-latex">\footnote[number]{text for footnote}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="图表自动标注typst胜出">图表&amp;自动标注:typst胜出</h3>
<p>pandoc这里完全依赖第三方插件，不推荐，很折腾。<br>
latex语法太冗长了。<br>
typst的表格没有markdown的表格语法直观，但typst的表格排版更好控制。</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>第三方插件 <a href="https://github.com/lierdakil/pandoc-crossref" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">pandoc-crossref</a><br>
如果要将 mermaid, plantuml 的代码块变成标号图，就需要自己折腾。<br>
我的方法是<a href="https://github.com/AClon314/md2doc/blob/main/convert.py" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">convert.py</a>里的正则替换来自动给<strong>表</strong>与<strong>图</strong>区分开，自动编号。需配合<a href="https://github.com/AClon314/pandoc-figure-caption-patch" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">pandoc-figure-caption-patch</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-markdown">---
## pandoc-figure-caption-patch
autoFigLabels: true

## crossref
chapters: true
chaptersDepth: 1
figureTitle: "图"
tableTitle: "表"
titleDelim: " "
chapDelim: "-"
figPrefix: [""]
tblPrefix: [""]
---

```mermaid
graph LR
A --&gt; B
```

: mermaid's caption {#fig:mermaid}

```plantuml
A -&gt; B
```

: uml's caption {#fig:uml}
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://typst.app/docs/reference/model/figure/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">typst</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-typst">@glacier shows a glacier. Glaciers are complex systems.

#figure(
  image("glacier.jpg", width: 80%),
  caption: [A curious figure.],
) &lt;glacier&gt;

#figure(
table(
  columns: 4,
  [t], [1], [2], [3],
  [y], [0.3s], [0.4s], [0.8s],
),
caption: [Timing results],
)
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>latex</p>
<pre><code class="language-latex">\begin{figure}[ht]        % [ht] 控制图片位置 (here, top)
\centering              % 图片居中
\includegraphics[width=0.5\textwidth]{example.jpg}

\caption{这是标题内容}   % 自动生成 "Figure 1: 这是标题内容"
\label{fig:my_image}    % 用于文中引用的标签
\end{figure}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="代码引用自动更新typst胜出">代码引用自动更新:typst胜出</h3>
<p>typst原生支持代码同步！</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>我自研的第三方插件 <a href="https://github.com/AClon314/pandoc-code-include" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">pandoc-code-include</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-markdown">```{.py include=convert.py snippet=main .numberLines}

```
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://typst.app/docs/reference/data-loading/read" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">typst</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-typst">#let text = read("code.py")
#raw(text, block: true, lang: "python")
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.overleaf.com/learn/latex/Code_listing" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">latex</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-latex">\usepackage{listings}

\begin{lstlisting}[caption={我的 Python 代码}, label={lst:example}, language=Python]
print("Hello World")
\end{lstlisting}

% 文中引用
如代码 \ref{lst:example} 所示...
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="语法">语法</h1>
<h2 id="markdown">markdown</h2>
<pre><code class="language-markdown">## 必读文档 Must Read

[👍 draw.io 流程图后期编辑](https://app.diagrams.net/): 支持导入 mermaid plantuml sql csv

[default table style 默认表格样式，✅MS-Word，❌WPS](https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/issues/3275#issuecomment-369198726)

[markdown转markdown：\$toc\$自定义目录位置](https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/wiki/Pandoc-Tricks#using-markdown-templates)

[用markdown写论文@geChunYu](https://ge-chunyu.github.io/posts/2019-11-pandoc-large-document/)

[用markdown写论文@st1020](https://st1020.com/write-thesis-with-markdown-part1/)

**关键词：** Markdown; Pandoc

\newpage

&lt;div custom-style="Title"&gt;
Based on pandoc word template
&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div custom-style="Abstract Title"&gt;
Abstract
&lt;/div&gt;

Write abstract here.

**Key Words:** Markdown; Pandoc

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;br section&gt;

# Heading 1

## Heading 2

### Heading 3

#### Heading 4

##### Heading 5

###### Heading 6

首段落 First Paragraph.
正文Normal, 正文字体Body Text. `Verbatim Char代码字体` [超链接Hyperlink](https://github.com/AClon314 "mouse-over-hint") 脚注Footnote [^1]

[^1]: footnote.

**Bold** _Italic_ ~~Delete~~

1. 有序列表
   1. 11
      1. 111
         1. 1111
            1. 11111
               1. 111111
   1. 12
1. 2

- 无序列表
  - 11
    - 111
      - 1111
        - 11111
          - 111111
  - 12
- 2

如表[@tbl:table]。如图[@fig:ID]。

| Compact |  b  |
| :-----: | :-: |
|    1    |  2  |

: simple_tables see https://pandoc.org/chunkedhtml-demo/8.9-tables.html {#tbl:table}

::: {custom-style="Figure"}
| a | b |
| :---: | :---: |
| 1 | 2 |
表{} 表名
:::

![invert](https://images7.memedroid.com/images/UPLOADED819/64a1d3e2c44ae.jpeg){#fig:ID}

```dot
digraph G {
    rankdir=TB;
    subgraph L {
        rank = same;
        b -&gt; a [dir=back];  // b ← a
    }
    subgraph R {
        rank = same;
        c -&gt; d;  // c → d
    }
    b -&gt; c
}
```

```plantuml
@startuml
Bob-&gt;Alice: Hi Alice
@enduml
```

```{.py include=convert.py snippet=main .numberLines}

```

&gt; quote

```python {.numberLines}
#!/bin/env python
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("👻")
```

\newpage

# 参考文献

:::
</code></pre>
<h2 id="typst">typst</h2>
<pre><code class="language-typst">== 必读文档 Must Read

- #link("https://app.diagrams.net/")[👍 draw.io 流程图后期编辑]: 支持导入 mermaid plantuml sql csv
- #link("https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/issues/3275#issuecomment-369198726")[default table style 默认表格样式，✅MS-Word，❌WPS]
- #link("https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/wiki/Pandoc-Tricks#using-markdown-templates")[markdown转markdown：$toc$自定义目录位置]
- #link("https://ge-chunyu.github.io/posts/2019-11-pandoc-large-document/")[用markdown写论文@geChunYu]
- #link("https://st1020.com/write-thesis-with-markdown-part1/")[用markdown写论文@st1020]

*关键词：* Markdown; Pandoc

#pagebreak()

#align(center)[
  #text(size: 18pt, weight: "bold")[Based on pandoc word template]
]

#align(center)[
  #text(size: 14pt, weight: "bold")[Abstract]
]

Write abstract here.

*Key Words:* Markdown; Pandoc

// Pandoc 的 &lt;br section&gt; 通常需要模板层处理，这里略去

= Heading 1
== Heading 2
=== Heading 3
==== Heading 4
===== Heading 5
====== Heading 6

首段落 First Paragraph.

正文Normal, 正文字体Body Text. `Verbatim Char代码字体` #link("https://github.com/AClon314")[超链接Hyperlink] 脚注Footnote#footnote[footnote.]

*Bold* _Italic_ #strike[Delete]

+ 有序列表
  + 11
    + 111
      + 1111
        + 11111
          + 111111
  + 12
+ 2

- 无序列表
  - 11
    - 111
      - 1111
        - 11111
          - 111111
  - 12
- 2

如表 @tbl:table。 如图 @fig:ID。

#figure(
  table(
    columns: 2,
    align: center,
    table.header([Compact], [b]),
    [1], [2],
  ),
  caption: [simple_tables see https://pandoc.org/chunkedhtml-demo/8.9-tables.html],
) &lt;tbl:table&gt;

#figure(
  table(
    columns: 2,
    align: center,
    table.header([a], [b]),
    [1], [2],
  ),
  caption: [表名],
)

#figure(
  image("https://images7.memedroid.com/images/UPLOADED819/64a1d3e2c44ae.jpeg"),
  caption: [invert],
) &lt;fig:ID&gt;

#raw(
  "digraph G {\n    rankdir=TB;\n    subgraph L {\n        rank = same;\n        b -&gt; a [dir=back];  // b ← a\n    }\n    subgraph R {\n        rank = same;\n        c -&gt; d;  // c → d\n    }\n    b -&gt; c\n}",
  block: true,
  lang: "dot",
)

#raw(
  "@startuml\nBob-&gt;Alice: Hi Alice\n@enduml",
  block: true,
  lang: "plantuml",
)

// Pandoc 的 include/snippet 属性没有直接等价物，通常改为手动读取或预处理
#let text = read("code.py")
#raw(text, block: true, lang: "py")

#quote[
  quote
]

#raw(
  "#!/bin/env python\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    print(\"👻\")",
  block: true,
  lang: "python",
)

#pagebreak()

= 参考文献

// 例如：#bibliography("refs.bib")
</code></pre>
<h2 id="latex">latex</h2>
<pre><code class="language-latex">\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage[normalem]{ulem} % \sout

\section{必读文档 Must Read}

\begin{itemize}
  \item \href{https://app.diagrams.net/}{👍 draw.io 流程图后期编辑}: 支持导入 mermaid plantuml sql csv
  \item \href{https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/issues/3275#issuecomment-369198726}{default table style 默认表格样式，✅MS-Word，❌WPS}
  \item \href{https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/wiki/Pandoc-Tricks#using-markdown-templates}{markdown转markdown：\$toc\$自定义目录位置}
  \item \href{https://ge-chunyu.github.io/posts/2019-11-pandoc-large-document/}{用markdown写论文@geChunYu}
  \item \href{https://st1020.com/write-thesis-with-markdown-part1/}{用markdown写论文@st1020}
\end{itemize}

\textbf{关键词：} Markdown; Pandoc

\newpage

\begin{center}
  {\LARGE\bfseries Based on pandoc word template\par}
  \vspace{1em}
  {\large\bfseries Abstract\par}
\end{center}

Write abstract here.

\textbf{Key Words:} Markdown; Pandoc

% Pandoc 的 &lt;br section&gt; 通常需要文档类或模板层处理

\section{Heading 1}
\subsection{Heading 2}
\subsubsection{Heading 3}
\paragraph{Heading 4}
\subparagraph{Heading 5}
\textbf{Heading 6}

首段落 First Paragraph.

正文Normal, 正文字体Body Text. \texttt{Verbatim Char代码字体} \href{https://github.com/AClon314}{超链接Hyperlink} 脚注Footnote\footnote{footnote.}

\textbf{Bold} \textit{Italic} \sout{Delete}

\begin{enumerate}
  \item 有序列表
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item 11
    \begin{enumerate}
      \item 111
      \begin{enumerate}
        \item 1111
        \begin{enumerate}
          \item 11111
          \begin{enumerate}
            \item 111111
          \end{enumerate}
        \end{enumerate}
      \end{enumerate}
    \end{enumerate}
    \item 12
  \end{enumerate}
  \item 2
\end{enumerate}

\begin{itemize}
  \item 无序列表
  \begin{itemize}
    \item 11
    \begin{itemize}
      \item 111
      \begin{itemize}
        \item 1111
        \begin{itemize}
          \item 11111
          \begin{itemize}
            \item 111111
          \end{itemize}
        \end{itemize}
      \end{itemize}
    \end{itemize}
    \item 12
  \end{itemize}
  \item 2
\end{itemize}

如表~\ref{tbl:table}。如图~\ref{fig:ID}。

\begin{table}[htbp]
  \centering
  \begin{tabular}{cc}
    \toprule
    Compact &amp; b \\
    \midrule
    1 &amp; 2 \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabular}
  \caption{simple\_tables see \url{https://pandoc.org/chunkedhtml-demo/8.9-tables.html}}
  \label{tbl:table}
\end{table}

\begin{table}[htbp]
  \centering
  \begin{tabular}{cc}
    \toprule
    a &amp; b \\
    \midrule
    1 &amp; 2 \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabular}
  \caption{表名}
\end{table}

\begin{figure}[htbp]
  \centering
  % 远程图片通常需要先下载到本地再插入
  \includegraphics[width=.6\linewidth]{invert.jpeg}
  \caption{invert}
  \label{fig:ID}
\end{figure}

\begin{lstlisting}[caption={Graphviz DOT}, language={}]
digraph G {
    rankdir=TB;
    subgraph L {
        rank = same;
        b -&gt; a [dir=back];  % b &lt;- a
    }
    subgraph R {
        rank = same;
        c -&gt; d;  % c -&gt; d
    }
    b -&gt; c
}
\end{lstlisting}

\begin{lstlisting}[caption={PlantUML}, language={}]
@startuml
Bob-&gt;Alice: Hi Alice
@enduml
\end{lstlisting}

% Pandoc 的 include/snippet 属性通常要改成预处理或 \lstinputlisting
\lstinputlisting[language=Python]{convert.py}

\begin{quote}
quote
\end{quote}

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Python, numbers=left]
#!/bin/env python
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("👻")
\end{lstlisting}
